name: Alameda del Valle (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle with its base along the upper edge and its apex at the middle of the lower edge, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Alameda del Valle (a tree and a bridge above waves).
history: Alameda del Valle adopted its arms and flag officially on 28 September 1993, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid on 6 October 1993; the flag is of proportion 2:3, the cloth red, with a white triangle whose vertices are at the upper hoist and fly corners and the centre of the lower edge.

features.role: triangle with its vertices at the upper corners and the middle of the lower edge
